name: Alok
introEn: Active aura that heals Alok and nearby allies, boosts their movement speed and drops music notes.
introHi: Ek Active Aura banata hai, jo Alok Aura aas-paas ke teammates ko heal karta hai, unki Movement Speed badhata hai aur Music Notes girata hai.
currentEn: Creates a 5m aura that increases movement speed by 15% and restores 5 HP/s for 10 seconds. While the aura is active, a music note drops 2m behind Alok every 2 seconds and lasts 5 seconds. Teammates who pick up a note gain 15% movement speed and 5 HP/s for 10 seconds. Multiple Drop the Beat auras do not stack.
currentHi: 5m ka Aura banataa hai, jo 10 seconds tak Movement Speed 15% badhata hai Aura har second 5 HP wapas deta hai. Aura active rehne par har 2 seconds mein Alok se 2m peeche Ek Music Note girataa hai, jo 5 seconds tak rehta hai. Note uthane wale teammates ko 10 seconds tak 15% Movement Speed aur 5 HP/s milta hai. Drop the Beat ke kai Aura ek-dusare ke saath stack nahi hote.

rows.hi: Music Note girane ka samay aur jagah
Music Note kitani dera rehta hai
Note uthane par milne wala Bonus

notesEn: While Alok's own skill is active, teammates' Alok auras give no benefit (OB53). Movement speed has a global maximum; bonuses from skills, items and events cannot exceed it (OB54). Since OB47 the awakened skill replaces the original for all players; both appearances remain available.
notesHi: Alok ki apni Skill active hone par teammates ke Alok Aura se use koi fayda nahi milta (OB53). Movement Speed ki Ek global maximum limit hai; Skills, items aur events se milne wale bonuses is limit ko paar nahi kara sakate (OB54). OB47 se sabhi players ke liye Awakened Skill ne original Skill ki jagah le li hai; donon appearances ab bhi available hain.
historyEn: OB39 (Mar 2023): HP recovery 5 to 3 HP/s, cooldown 50s to 45s.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Awakened Alok introduced.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): HP recovery 3 to 5 HP/s, movement speed 15%, duration 10s; music-note pickup healing 3 to 5 HP/s.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Awakened skill replaced the original for all players.
OB52 (9 Jan 2026): Fixed skill range not matching the visual range, and speed boost sometimes failing to apply.
OB53 (2 Apr 2026): Alok users no longer gain from teammates' Alok auras while their own skill is active.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): 9th Anniversary event Skill Boosts: Speed Remix (10m aura, teammates +16% speed) and Heal Remix (20 HP/s while active). Global movement-speed cap added.
historyHi: OB39 (Mar 2023): HP Recovery 5 se kam karke 3 HP/s aur Cooldown 50s se kam karke 45s kiya gaya.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Awakened Alok introduce kiya gaya.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): HP Recovery 3 se badha kar 5 HP/s, Movement Speed 15% aur Duration 10s ki gayi; Music Note uthane par Healing 3 se badha kar 5 HP/s ki gayi.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): sabhi players ke liye Awakened Skill ne original Skill ki jagah le li.
OB52 (9 Jan 2026): Skill ki range aur visual range mein antara hone aur Speed Boost kabhi-kabhi apply na hone ki problem theek ki gayi.
OB53 (2 Apr 2026): Alok ki apni Skill active hone par use teammates ke Alok Aura se fayda milanaa band hua.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): 9th Anniversary event mein Skill Boosts jode gaye: Speed Remix (10m Aura, teammates ko +16% Speed) aur Heal Remix (active rehne par 20 HP/s). Global Movement Speed cap jodi gayi.

name: A124
introEn: Electromagnetic wave that blocks enemy skills, deals damage and interrupts interactions.
introHi: Ek Electromagnetic wave chhodta hai, jo Enemy ki Skills block karti hai, Damage deti hai aur unki chal rahi interactions ko rokti hai.
currentEn: Unleashes an 8m electromagnetic wave. Enemies inside cannot activate skills, take 25 DMG, and have their interaction countdowns (such as reviving) interrupted.
currentHi: 8m ki Electromagnetic wave chhodta hai. Iske andar maujood Enemy apni Skills activate nahi kara paayenge, unhe 25 DMG milta hai aur unki interactions ka countdown (jaise revive karna) ruka jata hai.
notesEn: Skill can be cancelled while aiming. Joseph is immune to A124's interference.
notesHi: Aim karte samay Skill cancel ki ja sakti hai. Joseph, A124 ke interference se immune hai.
historyEn: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Reworked into an 8m wave that disables enemy skills.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Added 25 DMG, duration 30s to 20s, cooldown 75s to 50s, cancel while aiming.
historyHi: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Skill ko badalakara 8m ki Wave banaayaa gaya, jo Enemy ki Skills disable karti hai.
OB42 (Oct 2023): 25 DMG jodaa gaya; Duration 30s se kam karke 20s aur Cooldown 75s se kam karke 50s kiya gaya; Aim karte samay Skill cancel karne ka option jodaa gaya.

name: Andrew
introEn: Passive that slows armor durability loss and adds armor damage reduction, boosted by nearby teammates.
introHi: Ek Passive Skill, jo Armor ki Durability kama hone ki Speed ghataati hai aur Armor Damage Reduction deti hai. Aas-paas ke teammates se isakaa bonus badhataa hai.
currentEn: Armor loses durability 40% slower. Wolf Pack adds 4% armor damage reduction, plus 1% for every teammate within 15m.
currentHi: Armor ki Durability 40% dhimi Speed se kama hoti hai. Wolf Pack se 4% Armor Damage Reduction milta hai, saath hi 15m ke andar maujood har teammate ke liye 1% extra milta hai.
notesEn: Shield Points ignore armor damage-reduction buffs, so Wolf Pack does not reduce damage taken by Shield Points. The OB46 notes do not state whether teammates must also carry Wolf Pack. Since OB47 the awakened skill replaces the original for all players.
notesHi: Shield Points par Armor Damage Reduction ke buffs laagu nahi hote, isalie Wolf Pack Shield Points se hone wale Damage ko kama nahi karta. OB46 ke notes mein ye nahi bataayaa gaya ki teammates ke paasa bhi Wolf Pack honaa jaruri hai yaa nahi. OB47 se sabhi players ke liye Awakened Skill ne original Skill ki jagah le li hai.
historyEn: OB40 (Jun 2023): Armor durability loss reduction 20% to 25%.
OB41 (Aug 2023): Armor damage reduction 20% to 15%, teammate bonus 10% to 5%.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Armor durability loss reduction 25% to 40%; armor damage reduction 15% to 5%, +5% per teammate carrying the skill.
OB46 (Sep 2024): Now +4%, +1% per teammate within 15m.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Awakened skill replaced the original for all players.
historyHi: OB40 (Jun 2023): Armor Durability mein kami ka reduction 20% se badha kar 25% kiya gaya.
OB41 (Aug 2023): Armor Damage Reduction 20% se kam karke 15% aur Teammate Bonus 10% se kam karke 5% kiya gaya.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Armor Durability mein kami ka reduction 25% se badha kar 40% kiya gaya; Armor Damage Reduction 15% se kam karke 5% aur Skill rakhane wale har teammate ke liye +5% kiya gaya.
OB46 (Sep 2024): Bonus badalakara +4% aur 15m ke andar har teammate ke liye +1% kiya gaya.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): sabhi players ke liye Awakened Skill ne original Skill ki jagah le li.

name: Antonio
introEn: Passive that starts the match with extra Shield Points that recover after combat.
introHi: Ek Passive Skill, jo match ki shuruaata mein extra Shield Points deti hai. Combat se bachane ke baada ye Shield Points recover hote hain.
currentEn: Starts the match with 20 extra Shield Points. Shield Points recover after surviving combat.
currentHi: Match ki shuruaata mein 20 extra Shield Points milate hain. Combat se bachane ke baada Shield Points recover hote hain.

rows.hi: shuruaata mein milne wale Shield Points

rows.en: Armor damage reduction on Shield Points
rows.hi: Shield Points par Armor Damage Reduction

notesEn: Shield Points are removed before HP. Shield Points ignore armor damage-reduction buffs. Shield Points do not protect against Danger Zone, fall or bleeding damage.
notesHi: HP se pahale Shield Points kama hote hain. Shield Points par Armor Damage Reduction ke buffs laagu nahi hote. Shield Points, Danger Zone, girane yaa bleeding se hone wale Damage se nahi bachaate.
historyEn: OB41 (Aug 2023): 40 extra HP converted to 40 Shield Points.
OB46 (Sep 2024): Shield Points recovery speed 10 to 5 SP/s
historyHi: OB41 (Aug 2023): 40 extra HP ko badalakara 40 Shield Points kiya gaya.
OB43 (Jan 2024): 40 se kam karke 30 kiya gaya.
OB46 (Sep 2024): Shield Points ki Recovery Speed 10 se kam karke 5 SP/s ki gayi.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): 30 se kam karke 20 kiya gaya.

name: A-Patroa
lastChanged: No balance changes since release (OB34, May 2022)
introEn: Utility character with an exclusive extra skill slot; no personal combat skill.
introHi: Ek Utility character, jisake paasa Ek exclusive extra Skill Slot hai; isaki apni koi Combat Skill nahi hai.
currentEn: Adds one extra skill slot that can hold any skill owned on the account.
currentHi: Ek extra Skill Slot milta hai, jisamen account par owned koi bhi Skill rakhi jaa sakti hai.
historyEn: OB34 (May 2022): Released.
historyHi: OB34 (May 2022): Release kiya gaya.

name: Paloma
introEn: Passive that boosts weapon accuracy after she destroys a Gloo Wall.
introHi: Ek Passive Skill, jo Gloo Wall destroy karne ke baada Weapon Accuracy badhati hai.
currentEn: Destroying a Gloo Wall increases weapon accuracy for 10 seconds.
currentHi: Gloo Wall destroy karne par 10 seconds ke liye Weapon Accuracy badha jati hai.
notesEn: Garena does not publish the accuracy bonus value. Designed to break enemy cover and finish players hiding behind Gloo Walls.
notesHi: Garena, Accuracy Bonus ki exact value publish nahi karta. Ye Skill Enemy ke cover ko todane aur Gloo Wall ke peeche chhipe players ko khatma karne ke liye banaai gayi hai.
historyEn: OB49 (21 May 2025): Reworked. Her extra-ammo skill was replaced by Shatterburst.
historyHi: OB49 (21 May 2025): Skill ko rework kiya gaya. Extra-ammo Skill ki jagah Shatterburst ne li.

name: Laura
introEn: Passive that increases accuracy while Laura is scoped in.
introHi: Ek Passive Skill, jo Scope mein aim karte samay Accuracy badhati hai.
currentEn: Accuracy increases by 60% while scoped in.
currentHi: Scope mein rehte samay Accuracy 60% badha jati hai.
notesEn: Built to help long-range shooters land shots.
notesHi: ye Skill long-range shooters ko nishaanaa lagaane mein madada karne ke liye banaai gayi hai.
historyEn: OB28 (Jun 2021): Accuracy bonus raised, maximum 30% to 35%.
OB36 (Sep 2022): Maximum 35% to 50%.
historyHi: OB28 (Jun 2021): Accuracy Bonus ki maximum value 30% se badha kar 35% ki gayi.
OB36 (Sep 2022): Maximum value 35% se badha kar 50% ki gayi.
OB50 (30 Jul 2025): 50% se badha kar 60% ki gayi.

name: Rafael
introEn: Passive that silences sniper and marksman fire and speeds up bleeding on knocked-down enemies.
introHi: Ek Passive Skill, jo Sniper aur Marksman Rifles ki firing sound ko silent karti hai aur knock hue Enemy ki bleeding Speed badhati hai.

rows.hi: Knock hue Enemy ki Bleeding Speed

currentEn: With Sniper Rifles and Marksman Rifles, firing sound is silenced and enemies knocked down by Rafael bleed 85% faster.
currentHi: Sniper Rifles aur Marksman Rifles se fire karne par firing sound silent rehti hai. Rafael dvaaraa knock kie gaye Enemy ki bleeding Speed 85% badha jati hai.
notesEn: Works while using Sniper Rifles or Marksman Rifles.
notesHi: ye Skill Sniper Rifles yaa Marksman Rifles istemaala karte samay kaama karti hai.
historyEn: OB27 (Apr 2021): Became a passive skill that silences sniper and marksman fire.
OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Limited to Sniper and Marksman Rifles; bleed speed bonus raised, maximum 45% to 90%.
OB39 (Mar 2023): Skill description corrected to match the actual effect.
historyHi: OB27 (Apr 2021): Passive Skill banaai gayi, jo Sniper aur Marksman fire ko silent karti hai.
OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Skill ko Sniper aur Marksman Rifles tak simita kiya gaya; Bleed Speed Bonus ki maximum value 45% se badha kar 90% ki gayi.
OB39 (Mar 2023): Skill ka description actual effect ke anusaara theek kiya gaya.
OB40 (Jun 2023): 90% se kam karke 85% kiya gaya.

name: Jota
introEn: Passive that restores HP when Jota hits and knocks down enemies.
introHi: Ek Passive Skill, jo Jota ke Enemy ko hit karne aur knock karne par HP wapas deti hai.
currentEn: Hitting an enemy with guns restores some HP. Knocking down an enemy in any way restores 20% HP.
currentHi: Gun se Enemy ko hit karne par kuchha HP wapas milti hai. Kisi bhi tarike se Enemy ko knock karne par 20% HP wapas milti hai.
notesEn: Garena does not publish the HP restored per gun hit.
Before OB53, only knockdowns scored with guns triggered the recovery.
notesHi: Garena, har Gun Hit par wapas milne vaali HP ki exact value publish nahi karta.
OB53 se pahale Recovery sirpha Gun se kie gaye Knockdown par trigger hoti thi.
historyEn: Before OB29: SMG or Shotgun kills restored HP, 5-second cooldown.
OB29 (Aug 2021): Reworked so gun hits restore HP and knockdowns restore up to 20% max HP.
OB53 (2 Apr 2026): Any type of knockdown now triggers the recovery.
historyHi: OB29 se pahale: SMG yaa Shotgun se kill karne par HP wapas milti thi aur 5-second Cooldown tha.
OB29 (Aug 2021): Skill ko rework kiya gaya, taaki Gun Hits par HP wapas mile aur Knockdown par maximum HP ka 20% tak recover ho.
OB53 (2 Apr 2026): ab kisi bhi taraha ka Knockdown Recovery trigger karta hai.

name: Clu
introEn: Active scan that reveals enemy positions and shares them with the squad.
introHi: Ek Active Scan, jo Enemy ki positions dikhaataa hai aur unhe Squad ke saath share karta hai.
currentEn: Locates enemies within 80m who are not prone or crouching for 10 seconds. Enemy positions are shared with teammates.
currentHi: 10 seconds tak 80m ke andar maujood una Enemy ki location pataa chalati hai jo prone yaa crouch nahi kara rahe hote. Enemy ki positions teammates ke saath share hoti hain.
notesEn: Prone or crouching enemies are not revealed.
Scanned enemies get a notification on their minimap and screen.
notesHi: Prone yaa crouch kara rahe Enemy reveal nahi hote.
Scan hue Enemy ko unake Minimap aur screen par notification milta hai.
historyEn: OB34 (25 May 2022): Duration 5-7.5s to 5-10s, cooldown 75-60s to 75-50s by level.
OB37 (Nov 2022): Maximum scan range 75m to 65m.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Cooldown 50s to 45s; scanned enemies now get a notification.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Scan range 65m to 80m.
historyHi: OB34 (25 May 2022): Level ke hisaaba se Duration 5–7.5s se badha kar 5–10s aur Cooldown 75–60s se kam karke 75–50s kiya gaya.
OB37 (Nov 2022): Maximum Scan Range 75m se kam karke 65m ki gayi.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Cooldown 50s se kam karke 45s kiya gaya; Scan hue Enemy ko notification milne lagaa.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Scan Range 65m se badha kar 80m ki gayi.

name: Wolfrahh
introEn: Passive that grows with every elimination: tougher against headshots and stronger headshots.
introHi: Ek Passive Skill, jo har Elimination ke saath majabuta hoti hai: Headshot se bachaava badhataa hai aur Headshot Damage bhi badhataa hai.
currentEn: Every elimination adds one spectator, and spectators never decrease. Each spectator reduces headshot damage taken by 4% and increases headshot damage dealt by 10%.
currentHi: har Elimination par 1 Spectator judataa hai aur Spectators kama nahi hote. Har Spectator se liyaa gaya Headshot Damage 4% kama aur diya gaya Headshot Damage 10% badha jata hai.
notesEn: Maximum effect is reached at 3 spectators.
notesHi: Maximum Effect 3 Spectators par milta hai.
historyEn: OB22 (May 2020): Introduced.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Spectators required reduced from 6 to 3; limb damage bonus replaced with headshot damage bonus.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Headshot damage taken reduction 7% to 4% per spectator, maximum 21% to 12%.
historyHi: OB22 (May 2020): Introduce kiya gaya.
OB34 (25 May 2022): jaruri Spectators 6 se kam karke 3 kie gaye; Limb Damage Bonus ki jagah Headshot Damage Bonus diya gaya.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): har Spectator par liye gaye Headshot Damage mein kami 7% se kam karke 4% aur maximum kami 21% se kam karke 12% ki gayi.

name: Jai
introEn: Passive that refills Jai's magazine after a knockdown or an active skill.
introHi: Ek Passive Skill, jo Knockdown karne yaa Active Skill istemaala karne ke baada Jai ki Magazine refill karti hai.

rows.value: Knocking down an enemy or using an active skill
Assault Rifles, Pistols, SMGs, Shotguns, Sniper Rifles

currentEn: After knocking down an enemy or using an active skill, the gun's magazine reloads automatically to 100% of its maximum capacity.
currentHi: Enemy ko Knockdown karne yaa Active Skill istemaala karne ke baada Gun ki Magazine apane aapa usaki maximum capacity ke 100% tak refill ho jati hai.
notesEn: Works with Assault Rifles, Pistols, SMGs, Shotguns and Sniper Rifles. The active-skill trigger leaves Jai with a loaded weapon right after using a skill.
notesHi: Assault Rifles, Pistols, SMGs, Shotguns aur Sniper Rifles ke saath kaama karti hai. Active Skill istemaala karne ke turnta baada Jai ki Gun loaded rehti hai.
historyEn: Sep 2020 (Booyah Day): Reload capacity maximum 25% to 45%; Shotguns added.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Reworked. Magazine now refills after a knockdown or an active skill, to 100% for all weapon types including Sniper Rifles.
historyHi: Sep 2020 (Booyah Day): Maximum Reload Capacity 25% se badha kar 45% ki gayi; Shotguns jodi gain.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Skill ko rework kiya gaya. Ab Knockdown yaa Active Skill ke baada Magazine sabhi weapon types ke liye 100% tak refill hoti hai, jisamen Sniper Rifles bhi shaamila hain.

name: Alvaro
introEn: Passive that boosts explosive damage and range, and splits each grenade into mini grenades after it explodes.
introHi: Ek Passive Skill, jo Explosive Damage aur Range badhati hai. Grenade explode hone ke baada chhote Mini Grenades mein bnta jata hai.
currentEn: Explosive weapon damage increases by 20% and range increases by 10%. Each grenade splits into 3 mini grenades after exploding, dealing 20% of the original grenade's damage.
currentHi: Explosive Weapon Damage 20% aur Range 10% badha jati hai. Har Grenade explode hone ke baada 3 Mini Grenades mein bnta jata hai, jo original Grenade ke Damage ka 20% dete hain.
notesEn: Grenades split only after exploding, so grenade cooking is no longer disrupted (OB47). Since OB47 this skill replaces Art of Demolition for all players.
notesHi: Grenade ab sirpha explode hone ke baada split hote hain, isalie Grenade cook karne ki prakriyaa baadhita nahi hoti (OB47). OB47 se sabhi players ke liye is Skill ne Art of Demolition ki jagah le li hai.
historyEn: OB29 (Aug 2021): Art of Demolition damage bonus raised, maximum 16% to 20%.
OB39 (Mar 2023): Awakened Alvaro "Rageblast" introduced with Split Blitz: +20% damage, +10% range, grenades split into 3 extra grenades 1 second before detonating at 30% damage.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Split Blitz replaced Art of Demolition for all players; grenades now split after exploding, mini grenades deal 20%.
historyHi: OB29 (Aug 2021): Art of Demolition ka Damage Bonus maximum 16% se badha kar 20% kiya gaya.

OB39 (Mar 2023): Awakened Alvaro "Rageblast" ko Split Blitz ke saath introduce kiya gaya: +20% Damage, +10% Range; Grenades phatane se 1 second pahale 3 extra Grenades mein bntate the, jo 30% Damage dete the.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): sabhi players ke liye Split Blitz ne Art of Demolition ki jagah li; Grenades ab explode hone ke baada split hote hain aur Mini Grenades 20% Damage dete hain.

name: Miguel
introEn: Passive that restores EP for every enemy Miguel knocks down.
introHi: Ek Passive Skill, jo Miguel ke har Knockdown par EP wapas deti hai.
currentEn: Gains 200 EP for each knockdown.
currentHi: har Knockdown par 200 EP milate hain.
notesEn: Triggers on knockdowns, not eliminations. Can be paired with other recovery skills.
notesHi: ye Skill Knockdown par trigger hoti hai, Elimination par nahi. Ise dusari Recovery Skills ke saath use kiya jaa sakataa hai.
historyEn: OB35 (Aug 2022): Crazy Slayer now triggers on knockdowns instead of eliminations, 30-80 EP by level.
OB36 (Sep 2022): EP per knockdown 30-80 to 100-200.
historyHi: OB35 (Aug 2022): Crazy Slayer ab Elimination ki jagah Knockdown par trigger hoti hai; Level ke hisaaba se 30–80 EP milate hain.
OB36 (Sep 2022): har Knockdown par EP 30–80 se badha kar 100–200 kie gaye.

name: Nikita
introEn: Passive that speeds up reloads and reduces enemy healing on every hit.
introHi: Ek Passive Skill, jo Reload Speed badhati hai aur har Hit par Enemy ki Healing kama karti hai.

rows.hi: Hit hue Target ki Healing mein kami

currentEn: Reload speed increases by 20%. Every time Nikita hits an enemy, that target gets a 50% healing reduction for 6 seconds (maximum 50%).
currentHi: Reload Speed 20% badha jati hai. Nikita jaba bhi kisi Enemy ko hit karti hai, usa target ki Healing 6 seconds ke liye 50% kama ho jati hai (maximum 50%).
notesEn: Built to counter high-healing characters such as Ford and Kassie. Hits do not stack the reduction beyond the 50% maximum. A visual indicator now shows when you apply Healing Reduction on an enemy (OB54).
notesHi: ye Ford aur Kassie jaise zyada Healing dene wale characters ko counter karne ke liye upayogi hai. Hits se Healing Reduction 50% ki maximum limit se aage stack nahi hoti. OB54 mein ab Enemy par Healing Reduction apply hone par visual indicator dikhataa hai.
historyEn: OB37 (Nov 2022): Reload speed 14-24% to a flat 20%.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Reworked: reload speed +20%, 30% healing reduction for 10s.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Healing reduction 30% to 50%, duration 10s to 6s; reload speed 30%.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Reload speed 30% to 20%.
historyHi: OB37 (Nov 2022): Reload Speed 14–24% se badalakara fixed 20% ki gayi.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Rework kiya gaya: +20% Reload Speed aur 10s ke liye 30% Healing Reduction.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Healing Reduction 30% se badha kar 50%, Duration 10s se kam karke 6s; Reload Speed 30% ki gayi.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Reload Speed 30% se kam karke 20% ki gayi.

name: Kapella
introEn: Passive that lets any weapon heal teammates and boosts Heal Pistol healing.
introHi: Ek Passive Skill, jisase kisi bhi Weapon se teammates ko heal kiya jaa sakataa hai aur Heal Pistol ki Healing bhi badhati hai.
currentEn: Shooting teammates with any weapon heals them for 20% of the damage dealt. Heal Pistols have a 20% higher healing effect.
currentHi: kisi bhi Weapon se teammate ko shoot karne par die gaye Damage ka 20% use heal karta hai. Heal Pistols ki Healing Effect 20% badha jati hai.
notesEn: Pairs with the Heal Pistol-Y, which helps up downed teammates by shooting them (OB49).
notesHi: ye Heal Pistol-Y ke saath kaama karti hai, jisase down hue teammates ko shoot karake help up kiya jaa sakataa hai (OB49).
historyEn: OB21 (Apr 2020): Introduced with Healing Song.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Healing Song reworked: 80 HP shield and 10% speed boost on help-up, downed teammates bleed 35% slower.
OB44 (Apr 2024): Help-up speed boost 10% to 80%.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Reworked into Remedy Rounds.
historyHi: OB21 (Apr 2020): Healing Song ke saath introduce kiya gaya.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Healing Song rework hui: Help-up par 80 HP Shield aur 10% Speed Boost; down hue teammates ki Bleeding Speed 35% kam.
OB44 (Apr 2024): Help-up Speed Boost 10% se badha kar 80% kiya gaya.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Skill ko Remedy Rounds mein rework kiya gaya.

name: Joseph
introEn: Passive that grants immunity to disruptive effects and a short movement-speed boost.
introHi: Ek Passive Skill, jo pareshaana karne wale effects se immunity aur thode samay ke liye Movement Speed Boost deti hai.
currentEn: Become immune to disruptive effects (slowdown, marking, skill-silencing) and gain a 10% movement-speed boost for 5 seconds.
currentHi: Slowdown, marking aur Skill-silencing jaise disruptive effects se immunity milti hai aur 5 seconds ke liye Movement Speed 10% badha jati hai.
notesEn: Immune to Moco's marking, Homer's drone and A124's nano interference. Garena does not publish the exact trigger condition. Movement speed has a global maximum; bonuses from skills, items and events cannot exceed it (OB54).
notesHi: Moco ki Marking, Homer ki Drone aur A124 ke Nano Interference se immunity milti hai. Garena exact Trigger Condition publish nahi karta. Movement Speed ki Ek global maximum limit hai; Skills, items aur events ke bonuses is limit ko paar nahi kara sakate (OB54).
historyEn: OB35 (Jul 2022): Original skill Nutty Movement had its speed boost lowered.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Reworked into Silver Spoon: immunity and 10% speed for 5s, cooldown 60s.
OB44 (Apr 2024): Cooldown 60s to 45s.
historyHi: OB35 (Jul 2022): Original Skill Nutty Movement ka Speed Boost kama kiya gaya.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Silver Spoon mein rework kiya gaya: 5s ke liye immunity aur 10% Speed; Cooldown 60s.
OB44 (Apr 2024): Cooldown 60s se kam karke 45s kiya gaya.

name: Wukong
introEn: Active skill that turns Wukong into a bush for ambushes and repositioning.
introHi: Ek Active Skill, jo Wukong ko Bush mein badala deti hai taaki vaha Ambush kara sake aur apni Position badala sake.
currentEn: Transforms into a bush with a 10% reduction in movement speed for 10 seconds. The transformation ends when Wukong attacks. The cooldown resets if Wukong takes down an enemy within 10 seconds after releasing the skill.
currentHi: Wukong 10 seconds ke liye Bush mein badala jata hai aur usaki Movement Speed 10% kama ho jati hai. Wukong ke Attack karte hi Transformation khatma ho jata hai. Skill istemaala karne ke 10 seconds ke andar Wukong kisi Enemy ko knock karta hai, to Cooldown reset ho jata hai.

rows.value: On a takedown within 10 seconds of release

notesEn: Interactions that keep Camouflage: using Vending Machines, War Chests and Portal Go, eating Mushrooms, helping up teammates. Interactions that remove Camouflage: using vehicles, ziplines and Launch Pads (OB47).
notesHi: Camouflage ko banaae rakhane vaali interactions: Vending Machines, War Chests aur Portal Go istemaala karna, Mushrooms khaanaa aur teammates ko help up karna. Camouflage khatma karne vaali interactions: Vehicles, ziplines aur Launch Pads istemaala karna (OB47).
historyEn: Sep 2021: Movement speed reduced by 20% while camouflaged.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Speed reduction 20% to 10%.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Speed reduction 10% to 5%, cooldown 200s.
