historyHi: OB36 (21 Sep 2022): Gloo Wall Durability Recovery ko har 1s mein current Durability ke 20/22/24/26/28/30% se badha kar 40/42/44/46/48/50% kiya gaya.

OB41 (08 Aug 2023): Ice Iron mein darja kiya gaya ki Hit hone par deployed Gloo Walls 250 Durability/s recover karti hain; 5m ke andar teammates 20 HP/s recover karte the, har teammate ke liye har wall par 40 HP cap ke saath.
OB42 (30 Oct 2023): Gloo Wall Durability Recovery 250 se kam karke 150 per second ki gayi.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Durability Recovery 150 se badha kar 160 per second ki gayi; Teammate Recovery 20 se kam karke 10 HP/s aur deployment ke baada 3s tak ki gayi.
OB47 (02 Dec 2024): Deployment ke baada Effect Window 3s se kam karke 2s ki gayi.
OB50 (30 Jul 2025): Effect Window 2s se kam karke 1.5s aur Teammate Recovery 10 se kam karke 5 HP/s ki gayi.

source.label: Garena — Official Nairi full-body character artwork

tacticalEn: For a planned hold or rotation, deploy the Gloo Wall at the cover point your squad intends to use so its short restoration window begins while the team stabilizes.
Keep teammates within 5m during the brief HP-recovery window; call the regroup before spreading into separate angles.
Treat Ice Iron as a short support window, not sustained healing. Time the wall deployment around the squad's move rather than relying on repeated walls to stack recovery.
tacticalHi: Squad ko kisi jagah hold yaa rotate karna ho, to Gloo Wall usi cover point par lagaaen jahaan team rukane vaali hai, taaki team ke settle hote samay usaki chhoti Recovery Window shuru ho.
HP Recovery ki chhoti Window ke dauraana teammates ko 5m ke andar rakhen; alaga-alaga angles par phailane se pahale regroup call den.

Ice Iron ko thode samay ke Support Effect ki taraha len, lagaataara Healing ki taraha nahi. Baara-baara Gloo Wall lagaakara Recovery stack hone ki ummida na karen; deployment ka samay squad ki movement ke hisaaba se rakhen.
strengthsEn: Adds a short durability-restoration window to deployed Gloo Walls, helping the squad maintain temporary cover.
Provides nearby teammates with a small HP-recovery window when they stay within 5m.
strengthsHi: Deployed Gloo Walls ko thode samay ke liye extra Durability milti hai, jisase squad ka temporary cover banaa raha sakataa hai.
5m ke andar rehne wale teammates ko HP Recovery ki chhoti Window milti hai.
limitationsEn: The post-deployment effect window is only 1.5 seconds, so timing matters.
The teammate-healing effect does not stack from deploying multiple Gloo Walls.
Garena does not publish a current per-wall maximum HP recovery total for each teammate.
limitationsHi: Deployment ke baada Effect Window sirpha 1.5 seconds ki hai, isalie timing jaruri hai.
kai Gloo Walls lagaane se Teammate Healing Effect stack nahi hota.
Garena, har teammate ke liye Ek Gloo Wall se milne vaali current maximum HP Recovery publish nahi karta.

name: Otho
introEn: Passive ability that marks nearby enemy teammates after a knockdown and applies a short movement-speed reduction.
introHi: Ek Passive Ability, jo Knockdown ke baada aas-paas maujood Enemy teammates ko mark karti hai aur thode samay ke liye unki Movement Speed kama karti hai.
currentEn: After Otho knocks down an enemy, Memory Mist marks that enemy's teammates within 20m of the knocked-down enemy.
Marked enemies have their movement speed reduced by 25% for 3 seconds.
If Otho is knocked down by a nearby enemy, Memory Mist marks and slows the attacker and their teammates.
currentHi: Otho ke kisi Enemy ko Knockdown karne ke baada Memory Mist, Knock hue Enemy se 20m ke andar maujood usake teammates ko mark karti hai.
Mark hue Enemy ki Movement Speed 3 seconds ke liye 25% kama ho jati hai.
agara Otho ko koi paasa ka Enemy Knockdown karta hai, to Memory Mist usa attacker aur usake teammates ko mark karake unki Speed kama karti hai.
notesEn: The 20m range is stated for the enemy-knockdown trigger. Garena does not publish a separate numeric range for the self-knockdown trigger.
Garena does not publish the maximum number of players that Memory Mist can mark.
Garena does not publish a numeric cooldown for this passive ability.
notesHi: Enemy ko Knockdown karne wale Trigger ke liye 20m Range di gayi hai. Khuda Knockdown hone wale Trigger ki alaga numeric Range Garena publish nahi karta.
Memory Mist kitane maximum players ko mark kar sakti hai, ye Garena publish nahi karta.
Garena is Passive Ability ka numeric Cooldown publish nahi karta.
historyEn: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Maximum reveal range increased from 50m to 75m; teammate information-sharing duration increased from 4s to 6s.

OB39 (21 Mar 2023): Memory Mist reworked: after knocking down an enemy, it marks enemies within 20m of the knocked-down enemy and slows them by 25% for 4s; when Otho is knocked down, it also marks and slows nearby enemies.
OB53 (02 Apr 2026): The mark-and-slow duration changed from 4s to 3s.
historyHi: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Maximum Reveal Range 50m se badha kar 75m; Teammates ke saath Information Sharing Duration 4s se badha kar 6s ki gayi.

OB39 (21 Mar 2023): Memory Mist ko rework kiya gaya: Enemy ko Knockdown karne ke baada vaha Knock hue Enemy se 20m ke andar maujood Enemy ko mark karti hai aur 4s ke liye unki Speed 25% kama karti hai; Otho ke Knockdown hone par bhi aas-paas ke Enemy mark aur slow hote hain.
OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Mark aur Slow ki Duration 4s se kam karke 3s ki gayi.

source.label: Garena — Official Otho full-body character artwork

tacticalEn: After a knockdown, use the 20m mark around the downed opponent to call the nearby enemy positions before the squad commits to a follow-up.
The 3-second slow creates a brief timing advantage: coordinate a reposition, safer angle change or reset while the marked group is slowed.
If Otho is knocked down by a nearby enemy, immediately communicate the trigger so teammates know the attacker and nearby group have been marked and slowed.
tacticalHi: Knockdown ke baada down hue opponent ke aas-paas 20m mein mark hue Enemy ki location call karen, phira squad ko aage badhaaen.
3-second Slow se thode samay ka advantage milta hai: is dauraana position badalen, behatara angle len yaa reset karen.
agara Otho ko koi paasa ka Enemy Knockdown karta hai, to turnta teammates ko bataaen, taaki unhe pataa rahe ki attacker aur aas-paas ki team mark aur slow ho chuki hai.
strengthsEn: A knockdown can reveal the downed enemy's nearby teammates, giving the squad information for its next decision.
The 25% movement-speed reduction can briefly disrupt an enemy group's reposition.
The self-knockdown trigger can also mark and slow the nearby attacker and their teammates.
strengthsHi: Knockdown se down hue Enemy ke aas-paas maujood teammates ki location pataa chala sakti hai, jisase squad agalaa phaisalaa le sakti hai.
25% Movement Speed Reduction kuchha samay ke liye Enemy team ki repositioning bigaada sakti hai.
khuda Knockdown hone par bhi ye paasa ke attacker aur usake teammates ko mark aur slow kar sakti hai.
limitationsEn: The main trigger requires Otho to knock down an enemy; it is not a continuous scan.
The published 20m range is measured from the knocked-down enemy. Garena does not publish a separate numeric range for the self-knockdown trigger.
The mark-and-slow effect lasts only 3 seconds, and Garena does not publish a maximum mark count.
limitationsHi: mukhya Trigger ke liye Otho ko Enemy Knockdown karna jaruri hai; ye lagaataara chalane wala Scan nahi hai.
bataai gayi 20m Range, Knock hue Enemy se maapi jati hai. Khuda Knockdown hone wale Trigger ki alaga numeric Range Garena publish nahi karta.
Mark aur Slow Effect sirpha 3 seconds rehta hai aur maximum mark count Garena publish nahi karta.

name: Leon
introEn: Passive ability that restores HP after Leon survives combat.
introHi: Ek Passive Ability, jo Combat se bacha nikalane ke baada Leon ko HP wapas deti hai.
currentEn: After surviving combat, Leon recovers 60 HP at a rate of 4 HP per second for 15 seconds.
currentHi: Combat se bachane ke baada Leon 15 seconds tak har second 4 HP ki dara se total 60 HP recover karta hai.
notesEn: The recovery begins after the game registers that Leon has survived combat.
Garena does not publish the exact combat-disengagement timer that determines when the recovery trigger begins.
Garena does not publish a numeric cooldown for this passive ability.
notesHi: Game dvaaraa Leon ke Combat se bacha nikalane ki pushti karne ke baada Recovery shuru hoti hai.
Recovery Trigger shuru hone ka exact Combat-disengagement timer Garena publish nahi karta.
Garena is Passive Ability ka numeric Cooldown publish nahi karta.
historyEn: OB38 (11 Jan 2023): Maximum recovery increased from 30 HP to 60 HP; recovery rate changed from 5 to 4 HP/s; maximum recovery duration changed from 6s to 15s.
historyHi: OB38 (11 Jan 2023): Maximum Recovery 30 HP se badha kar 60 HP ki gayi; Recovery Rate 5 se kam karke 4 HP/s aur Maximum Recovery Duration 6s se badha kar 15s ki gayi.

source.label: Garena — Official Leon full-body character artwork

tacticalEn: After an engagement ends, create space behind cover and let Buzzer Beater's recovery tick before taking another contested position.
Use the recovery window to regroup with teammates and prepare the next rotation instead of treating the passive as an emergency instant heal.
Call out when you are disengaging so the squad can avoid leaving Leon isolated while the recovery is taking effect.
tacticalHi: Engagement khatma hone ke baada cover ke peeche jagah banaaen aur dusari contested position lene se pahale Buzzer Beater ki Recovery hone den.
Recovery Window ka istemaala teammates ke saath regroup aur agali rotation ki taiyaari ke liye karen; ise turnta milne vaali Emergency Heal na samajhen.
jaba aapa fight se disengage kara rahe hon to teammates ko call den, taaki Recovery ke dauraana Leon akelaa na chhute.
strengthsEn: Provides up to 60 HP of recovery after surviving combat without requiring a manual activation.
The 15-second recovery window can support a reset between engagements.
strengthsHi: Manual Activation ke binaa Combat se bachane ke baada maximum 60 HP Recovery milti hai.
15-second Recovery Window do engagements ke bicha reset karne mein madada kar sakti hai.
limitationsEn: Recovery is gradual at 4 HP/s, not an instant HP burst.
The trigger is tied to surviving combat; Garena does not publish the exact disengagement timer.
It does not replace cover or teammate support during an active engagement.
limitationsHi: Recovery dhire-dhire 4 HP/s ki dara se hoti hai, turnta HP nahi milti.
Trigger, Combat se bachane par nirbhara hai; exact disengagement timer Garena publish nahi karta.
Active Engagement ke dauraana ye cover yaa teammate support ki jagah nahi leti.

name: Koda
introEn: Active ability that activates an aurora effect, increases movement speed and periodically reveals enemies behind cover.
introHi: Ek Active Ability, jo Aurora Effect chaalu karti hai, Movement Speed badhati hai aur samay-samay par cover ke peeche maujood Enemy ko reveal karti hai.
currentEn: Activates the Aurora power for 8 seconds and increases movement speed by 15%.
Reveals enemies behind cover within 50m every 1 second; crouching or prone enemies cannot be detected.
While parachuting, highlights enemy locations within the field of view, but the effect is not shared with teammates.
currentHi: 8 seconds ke liye Aurora Power activate hoti hai aur Movement Speed 15% badha jati hai.
har 1 second mein 50m ke andar cover ke peeche maujood Enemy reveal hote hain; crouch yaa prone Enemy detect nahi hote.
Parachuting ke dauraana Field of View mein aane vaali Enemy ki locations highlight hoti hain, lekina ye Effect teammates ke saath share nahi hota.
notesEn: The parachuting highlight is visible only to Koda's user.

OB54 lists two optional BR Skill Boosts, separate from the base Aurora Vision values: Synced Vision marks enemies revealed during the first detection interval for 3 seconds and shares the information with teammates; Imprinted Vision applies up to 3 stacks, with 10 additional DMG per stack when the imprints are activated by an attack.
Only one of the two Skill Boost options can be selected. OB54 did not change the base duration, movement-speed bonus, detection range or cooldown.
notesHi: Parachuting ke dauraana milne wala Highlight sirpha Koda ko dikhaai deta hai.

OB54 mein do optional BR Skill Boosts die gaye hain, jo base Aurora Vision values se alaga hain: Synced Vision, pahale Detection Interval mein reveal hue Enemy ko 3 seconds ke liye mark karake jaanakaari teammates ke saath share karta hai; Imprinted Vision maximum 3 stacks lagaataa hai, aur Attack se Imprints activate hone par har stack 10 extra DMG deta hai.
donon Skill Boost options mein se sirpha Ek chunaa jaa sakataa hai. OB54 mein base Duration, Movement Speed Bonus, Detection Range yaa Cooldown nahi badale gaye.
historyEn: OB47 (02 Dec 2024): Koda introduced with a 10s Aurora duration, +10% movement speed, 50m detection every 1s, a 60s cooldown, and a parachuting highlight not shared with teammates.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Movement-speed bonus increased from 10% to 15%; cooldown reduced from 60s to 45s.
OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Aurora duration reduced from 10s to 8s.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Two optional BR Skill Boosts were listed again: Synced Vision (3s shared mark) and Imprinted Vision (up to 3 stacks; 10 DMG per stack when activated).
historyHi: OB47 (02 Dec 2024): Koda ko 10s Aurora Duration, +10% Movement Speed, har 1s mein 50m Detection, 60s Cooldown aur teammates ke saath share na hone wale Parachuting Highlight ke saath introduce kiya gaya.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Movement Speed Bonus 10% se badha kar 15%; Cooldown 60s se kam karke 45s kiya gaya.
OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Aurora Duration 10s se kam karke 8s ki gayi.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): do optional BR Skill Boosts phira se die gaye: Synced Vision (3s Shared Mark) aur Imprinted Vision (maximum 3 stacks; activate hone par har stack 10 DMG).

source.label: Garena — Official Koda full-body character artwork

tacticalEn: Activate Aurora Vision before entering a contested rotation or checking likely enemy cover, then share each reveal with the squad through clear callouts.
Use the 15% movement-speed bonus to reposition with teammates while the detection window is active; do not assume every enemy will be revealed.
During parachuting, use the personal field-of-view highlights to call out visible locations because that information is not shared automatically with teammates.
tacticalHi: Contested rotation mein jaane yaa snbhaavita enemy cover check karne se pahale Aurora Vision activate karen, phira har reveal ki jaanakaari squad ko saapha callouts mein den.
Detection Window active rehte hue 15% Movement Speed Bonus ka istemaala teammates ke saath reposition karne mein karen; ye na maanen ki har Enemy reveal ho jaaegaa.
Parachuting ke dauraana Field of View mein dikhane vaali locations call karen, kyonki ye jaanakaari apane aapa teammates ke saath share nahi hoti.
strengthsEn: Periodically reveals enemies behind cover within 50m, excluding crouching and prone targets.
Adds a 15% movement-speed bonus during the 8-second Aurora window.
Can highlight visible enemy locations during parachuting for the user.
strengthsHi: 50m ke andar cover ke peeche maujood Enemy ko samay-samay par reveal karti hai; crouching aur prone targets detect nahi hote.
8-second Aurora Window ke dauraana 15% Movement Speed Bonus deti hai.
Parachuting ke dauraana user ko visible enemy locations highlight kar sakti hai.
limitationsEn: The active window lasts 8 seconds and the cooldown is 45 seconds.
Crouching and prone enemies cannot be detected by the behind-cover scan.
Parachuting highlights are not shared with teammates.
OB54 Skill Boosts are optional BR enhancements and are separate from the base Aurora Vision values.
limitationsHi: Active Window 8 seconds ki hai aur Cooldown 45 seconds hai.
Behind-cover Scan se crouching aur prone Enemy detect nahi hote.
Parachuting Highlights teammates ke saath share nahi hote.
OB54 Skill Boosts optional BR enhancements hain aur base Aurora Vision values se alaga hain.

name: Thiva
introEn: Passive support ability that speeds up teammate help-ups and restores HP to the teammate who is successfully helped up.
introHi: Ek Passive Support Ability, jo teammates ko help up karne ki Speed badhati hai aur saphalataapurvaka help up hue teammate ko HP wapas deti hai.
currentEn: The speed of helping up teammates is increased by 70%.
After a successful help-up, the helped-up teammate recovers 60 HP over 3 seconds.
currentHi: Teammates ko help up karne ki Speed 70% badha jati hai.
saphala Help-up ke baada usa teammate ko 3 seconds mein 60 HP wapas milti hai.
notesEn: The HP recovery is applied to the teammate who was successfully helped up.
notesHi: HP Recovery usi teammate ko milti hai jise saphalataapurvaka help up kiya gaya ho.
historyEn: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Maximum help-up speed increased from 25% to 30%; HP recovery after a successful rescue increased from 40 HP to 50 HP over 5s.
OB40 (30 May 2023): Vital Vibes reworked to +70% help-up speed, 60s cooldown and 100 HP recovered by the helped-up teammate over 3s.
OB42 (30 Oct 2023): Cooldown increased from 60s to 90s; helped-up teammate recovery reduced from 100 HP to 60 HP over 3s.
historyHi: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Maximum Help-up Speed 25% se badha kar 30%; saphala Rescue ke baada HP Recovery 40 HP se badha kar 5s mein 50 HP ki gayi.
OB40 (30 May 2023): Vital Vibes ko rework karake +70% Help-up Speed, 60s Cooldown aur help-up hue teammate ko 3s mein 100 HP Recovery di gayi.
OB42 (30 Oct 2023): Cooldown 60s se badha kar 90s; help-up hue teammate ki Recovery 3s mein 100 HP se kam karke 60 HP ki gayi.

source.label: Garena — Official Thiva full-body character artwork

tacticalEn: Prioritize a safe help-up behind cover when a teammate is downed; Thiva's 70% faster help-up speed shortens the time the squad must stay committed to the rescue.
After a successful help-up, keep the rescued teammate with the squad while the 60 HP recovery is applied over 3 seconds.
Track the 90-second cooldown and coordinate the next rescue window rather than assuming Vital Vibes is always available.
tacticalHi: Teammate Knockdown hone par cover ke peeche surakshita Help-up ko priority den; Thiva ki 70% faster Help-up Speed se Rescue ke dauraana squad ko kama samay tak exposed rahanaa padataa hai.
Successful Help-up ke baada rescued teammate ko squad ke saath rakhen, taaki use 3 seconds mein milne vaali 60 HP Recovery ka fayda mila sake.
90-second Cooldown ka dhyaana rakhen aur agali Rescue Window coordinate karen; Vital Vibes ko har samay available na maanen.
strengthsEn: Increases teammate help-up speed by 70%, reducing the time needed to complete a rescue.
The successfully helped-up teammate receives 60 HP over 3 seconds.
strengthsHi: Teammate Help-up Speed 70% badhati hai, jisase Rescue puraa karne mein kama samay lagataa hai.
saphalataapurvaka help up hue teammate ko 3 seconds mein 60 HP milti hai.
limitationsEn: The ability has a 90-second cooldown.
The 60 HP recovery applies only after a successful help-up.
It does not provide a direct benefit while all teammates are already standing.
limitationsHi: is Ability ka Cooldown 90 seconds hai.
60 HP Recovery sirpha successful Help-up ke baada milti hai.
jaba sabhi teammates pahale se khade hon, taba ye sidhaa koi fayda nahi deti.

name: Dimitri
introEn: Active healing zone that restores HP to Dimitri and nearby allies, and automatically starts self-recovery for downed players inside it.
introHi: Ek Active Healing Zone, jo Dimitri aur aas-paas ke allies ko HP wapas deti hai. Iske andar Knock hue players ka Self-recovery apane aapa shuru ho jata hai.
currentEn: Creates a healing zone with a 3.5m radius.
Dimitri and allies inside the zone recover 10 HP per second.
When Dimitri or an ally is downed inside the zone, self-recovery automatically starts when needed.
The zone lasts 12 seconds. Cooldown: 90 seconds.
currentHi: 3.5m Radius wala Healing Zone banata hai.
Zone ke andar Dimitri aur allies har second 10 HP recover karte hain.
Zone ke andar Dimitri yaa koi ally Knockdown ho jaae, to jarurata padane par Self-recovery apane aapa shuru ho jata hai.
Zone 12 seconds tak rehta hai. Cooldown: 90 seconds.
notesEn: OB40 states that the help-up effect can be enhanced by other skills.
During self-recovery, players can move and no longer lose HP (OB34).
Garena does not publish a separate maximum number of self-recovery activations within one zone.
notesHi: OB40 ke ke mutabik Help-up Effect ko dusari Skills se badhaayaa jaa sakataa hai.
Self-recovery ke dauraana players move kara sakate hain aur unki HP kama nahi hoti (OB34).
Ek Zone ke andar Self-recovery kitani baara activate ho sakataa hai, isaki maximum snkhyaa Garena publish nahi karta.
historyEn: 4th Anniversary (04 Aug 2021): Introduced Healing Heartbeat — 3.5m healing zone, 3 HP/s, up to 15s duration and 60s cooldown at maximum level; downed users and allies could self-recover.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Self-recovery was improved so players could move during it without losing HP.
OB37 (21 Sep 2022): HP recovery increased from 3 to 5 HP/s.
OB40 (30 May 2023): HP recovery increased from 5 to 10 HP/s; downed players inside the zone automatically began self-recovery when needed; zone duration became 12s and cooldown was 60s.
OB42 (30 Oct 2023): Cooldown increased from 60s to 90s.
historyHi: 4th Anniversary (04 Aug 2021): Healing Heartbeat introduce hua — 3.5m Healing Zone, 3 HP/s, maximum level par 15s tak Duration aur 60s Cooldown; Knock hue users aur allies khuda Self-recover kara sakate the.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Self-recovery ko behatara kiya gaya, taaki iske dauraana players binaa HP khoe move kara saken.
OB37 (21 Sep 2022): HP Recovery 3 se badha kar 5 HP/s ki gayi.

OB40 (30 May 2023): HP Recovery 5 se badha kar 10 HP/s ki gayi; Zone ke andar Knock hue players ka Self-recovery jarurata padane par apane aapa shuru hone lagaa; Zone Duration 12s aur Cooldown 60s hua.
OB42 (30 Oct 2023): Cooldown 60s se badha kar 90s kiya gaya.

hiddenMechanics.text: While self-recovering, the player can move and no longer loses HP (OB34).

tacticalEn: Call the healing zone before regrouping so nearby teammates know where its support area is centered.
If a teammate is downed inside the zone, communicate that self-recovery may start automatically; do not assume the area is safe from interruption.
tacticalHi: Regroup karne se pahale Healing Zone ki location call karen, taaki teammates ko usakaa Support Area pataa rahe.
agara Zone ke andar koi teammate Knockdown ho jaae, to bataaen ki usakaa Self-recovery apane aapa shuru ho sakataa hai; ye na maanen ki vaha jagah interruption se puri taraha safe hai.
strengthsEn: Provides HP recovery to Dimitri and nearby allies during the active zone.
Can automatically start self-recovery for downed players inside the zone.
strengthsHi: Active Zone ke dauraana Dimitri aur aas-paas ke allies ko HP Recovery milti hai.
Zone ke andar Knock hue players ka Self-recovery apane aapa shuru kara sakataa hai.
limitationsEn: The support area is limited to a 3.5m radius and lasts 12 seconds.
The 90-second cooldown means the zone is not continuously available.
limitationsHi: Support Area sirpha 3.5m Radius tak simita hai aur 12 seconds tak rehta hai.
90-second Cooldown ke kaarana Zone lagaataara available nahi rehta.

name: Skyler
introEn: Active sonic-wave skill that damages Gloo Walls in an area and can store up to two charges.
introHi: Ek Active Sonic-wave Skill, jo Area mein Gloo Walls ko Damage karti hai aur maximum do Charges store kar sakti hai.
currentEn: Unleashes a sonic wave forward; OB55 states that the actual skill-effect range is over 100m, but does not publish an exact distance.
When the wave hits an obstacle, it explodes and deals 500 DMG per second to Gloo Walls within a 4m radius.
The damage effect lasts 6 seconds. Cooldown: 45 seconds. Up to 2 skill charges can be stored.
HP recovery is not included in the current base-skill values used here; the OB38 rework removed Skyler's healing effect.
currentHi: aage ki tarapha Sonic Wave chhodta hai; OB55 ke ke mutabik Skill ka actual effect range 100m se zyada hai, lekina exact distance publish nahi ki gayi.
Wave kisi obstacle se takaraane par explode hoti hai aur 4m Radius ke andar Gloo Walls ko har second 500 DMG deti hai.
Damage Effect 6 seconds tak rehta hai. Cooldown: 45 seconds. Maximum 2 Skill Charges store ho sakti hain.
yahaan istemaala kie gaye current base-skill values mein HP Recovery shaamila nahi hai; OB38 rework mein Skyler ka Healing Effect hataa diya gaya tha.
notesEn: OB55 says the skill-effect visibility was extended to match the actual range of over 100m. Garena does not publish the exact range.

OB54 introduced two optional BR Skill Boosts: Sticky Rhythm creates a small area that follows the nearest enemy and damages Gloo Walls inside it; Split Rhythm searches for Gloo Walls within 75m, locks onto target walls for 15s and sends waves toward up to 3 walls. Exact damage values for these boosts are not published.
Only one Skill Boost option can be selected for the skill in a match.
OB47 added aim assistance toward Gloo Walls; OB49 added an obstacle indicator to the aiming line.
notesHi: OB55 ke ke mutabik Skill Effect ki visibility ko actual range yaani 100m se zyada ke anusaara badhaayaa gaya. Garena exact range publish nahi karta.

OB54 mein do optional BR Skill Boosts jode gaye: Sticky Rhythm Ek chhotaa Area banata hai jo sabase najadiki Enemy ke peeche chalataa hai aur usake andar Gloo Walls ko Damage karta hai; Split Rhythm 75m ke andar Gloo Walls khojataa hai, 15s tak target walls ko lock karta hai aur maximum 3 walls ki tarapha waves bhejataa hai. Ina boosts ki exact Damage values publish nahi ki gain.
Ek match mein Skill ke liye sirpha Ek Skill Boost option chunaa jaa sakataa hai.
OB47 mein Gloo Walls ki tarapha Aim Assistance jodi gayi; OB49 mein Aiming Line par Obstacle Indicator jodaa gaya.
historyEn: OB34 (25 May 2022): At maximum level, cooldown increased from 40s to 60s; each deployed Gloo Wall granted HP recovery, up to 9 points, and recovery effects did not stack.
OB38 (11 Jan 2023): Reworked into area damage over time; maximum wave range 100m, 3.5m damage radius, 4s duration and 50s cooldown. HP recovery was removed.
OB40 (30 May 2023): Damage radius increased from 3.5m to 4m; duration increased from 4s to 5s; cooldown reduced from 50s to 45s.
OB41 (08 Aug 2023): Duration increased from 5s to 6s; cooldown reduced from 45s to 40s.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Added up to 2 stored charges; published values were 500 DMG/s within 4m for 6s, with a 45s cooldown and up to 100m wave range.
OB47 (02 Dec 2024): Added aim assistance toward Gloo Walls.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Added an obstacle indicator to the skill's aiming line.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Added optional BR Skill Boosts Sticky Rhythm and Split Rhythm.
OB55 (10 Sep 2026): Extended skill-effect visibility to match the actual range of over 100m; the exact range was not published.
historyHi: OB34 (25 May 2022): Maximum Level par Cooldown 40s se badha kar 60s kiya gaya; har deployed Gloo Wall se maximum 9 points tak HP Recovery milti thi aur Recovery Effects stack nahi hote the.
OB38 (11 Jan 2023): Area Damage over Time mein rework kiya gaya; maximum Wave Range 100m, Damage Radius 3.5m, Duration 4s aur Cooldown 50s hua. HP Recovery hataa di gayi.
OB40 (30 May 2023): Damage Radius 3.5m se badha kar 4m; Duration 4s se badha kar 5s; Cooldown 50s se kam karke 45s kiya gaya.
OB41 (08 Aug 2023): Duration 5s se badha kar 6s; Cooldown 45s se kam karke 40s kiya gaya.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Maximum 2 Stored Charges jodi gain; published values 4m ke andar 6s tak 500 DMG/s, 45s Cooldown aur maximum 100m Wave Range thin.
OB47 (02 Dec 2024): Gloo Walls ki tarapha Aim Assistance jodi gayi.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Skill ki Aiming Line par Obstacle Indicator jodaa gaya.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Optional BR Skill Boosts Sticky Rhythm aur Split Rhythm jode gaye.
OB55 (10 Sep 2026): Skill Effect Visibility ko 100m se zyada actual range ke anusaara badhaayaa gaya; exact range publish nahi ki gayi.

hiddenMechanics.text: Riptide Rhythm receives aim assistance toward Gloo Walls (OB47).
An obstacle indicator appears on the aiming line (OB49).

tacticalEn: Communicate the intended route before relying on a Gloo Wall interaction; teammates should know which area is being affected.
Treat the exact wave range as unpublished: OB55 confirms it is over 100m but gives no precise distance.
tacticalHi: Gloo Wall interaction par nirbhara hone se pahale intended route call karen, taaki teammates ko pataa ho ki kisa Area par effect padegaa.
Wave ki exact Range ko unpublished maanen: OB55 sirpha confirm karta hai ki ye 100m se zyada hai, exact distance nahi bataataa.
strengthsEn: The sonic-wave effect can affect Gloo Walls within a 4m radius for 6 seconds.
The skill can store up to two charges.
strengthsHi: Sonic-wave Effect 4m Radius ke andar Gloo Walls ko 6 seconds tak prabhaavita kara sakataa hai.
Skill maximum do Charges store kar sakti hai.
limitationsEn: The exact actual range above 100m is not published by Garena.
The skill has a 45-second cooldown; stored charges do not make it continuously available.
limitationsHi: 100m se zyada ki exact actual Range Garena ne publish nahi ki hai.
Skill ka Cooldown 45 seconds hai; Stored Charges hone ka matalaba ye nahi ki Skill lagaataara available rahegi.

name: Xayne
introEn: Active skill that grants temporary Shield Points, which refill and refresh the skill duration when Xayne knocks down an enemy.
introHi: Ek Active Skill, jo temporary Shield Points deti hai. Xayne ke Enemy ko Knockdown karne par Shield Points phira bhara jaate hain aur Skill Duration reset ho jati hai.
currentEn: Enters the Xtreme state and instantly gains 70 temporary Shield Points for 15 seconds.
Each enemy knockdown during the state restores the temporary Shield Points from this skill back to 70 and resets the state duration.
When the state ends, the Shield Points gained through this skill are removed. Cooldown: 75 seconds.
currentHi: Xtreme State activate hoti hai aur turnta 15 seconds ke liye 70 temporary Shield Points milate hain.
is State ke dauraana har enemy Knockdown par is Skill ke temporary Shield Points wapas 70 ho jaate hain aur State Duration reset ho jati hai.
State khatma hone par is Skill se mile Shield Points hata jaate hain. Cooldown: 75 seconds.

rows.value: Garena does not publish this value

notesEn: The temporary Shield Points from Xtreme Encounter are removed when the state ends; they are not permanent HP.
Each enemy knockdown during the active state restores this skill's temporary Shield Points to 70 and resets the duration.
Garena does not publish a maximum number of duration refreshes.
notesHi: Xtreme Encounter se mile temporary Shield Points, State khatma hone par hata jaate hain; ye permanent HP nahi hain.
Active State ke dauraana har enemy Knockdown par is Skill ke temporary Shield Points wapas 70 ho jaate hain aur Duration reset hoti hai.
Duration kitani baara maximum refresh ho sakti hai, ye Garena publish nahi karta.
historyEn: Patch Note: World Series (14 Apr 2021): Introduced with 80 temporary HP, up to 100% increased damage to Gloo Walls and shields, 10s duration and 100s cooldown at maximum level.
Illuminate (19 Jan 2022): Maximum Gloo Wall/shield damage bonus increased from 100% to 130%; duration increased from 10s to 15s. Maximum cooldown remained 100s.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Temporary HP increased from 80 to 120; maximum Gloo Wall/shield damage bonus increased from 130% to 200%; duration reduced from 15s to 6s.
OB46 (01 Sep 2024): Reworked from temporary HP to 60 temporary Shield Points for 12s; each enemy knockdown restored the shield to 60 and reset duration; cooldown became 75s.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Temporary Shield Points reduced from 60 to 50; duration remained 12s and cooldown remained 75s.
OB52 (09 Jan 2026): Temporary Shield Points increased from 50 to 70 and duration increased from 12s to 15s; cooldown remained 75s.
historyHi: Patch Note: World Series (14 Apr 2021): 80 temporary HP, Gloo Walls aur Shields par maximum 100% extra Damage, 10s Duration aur maximum level par 100s Cooldown ke saath introduce kiya gaya.
Illuminate (19 Jan 2022): Maximum Gloo Wall/Shield Damage Bonus 100% se badha kar 130%; Duration 10s se badha kar 15s ki gayi. Maximum Cooldown 100s hi rahaa.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Temporary HP 80 se badha kar 120; Maximum Gloo Wall/Shield Damage Bonus 130% se badha kar 200%; Duration 15s se kam karke 6s ki gayi.
OB46 (01 Sep 2024): Temporary HP ki jagah 12s ke liye 60 temporary Shield Points die gaye; har enemy Knockdown par Shield 60 tak refill aur Duration reset hoti thi; Cooldown 75s hua.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Temporary Shield Points 60 se kam karke 50 kie gaye; Duration 12s aur Cooldown 75s rahe.
OB52 (09 Jan 2026): Temporary Shield Points 50 se badha kar 70 aur Duration 12s se badha kar 15s ki gayi; Cooldown 75s rahaa.
tacticalEn: Tell teammates when the temporary Shield Point state begins and when it expires so they do not mistake it for permanent protection.
A knockdown during the active state refreshes the Shield Points and duration; the profile does not assume a maximum refresh count.
tacticalHi: Teammates ko bataaen ki temporary Shield Point State kaba shuru aur khatma hoti hai, taaki ve ise permanent Protection na samajhen.
Active State ke dauraana Knockdown hone par Shield Points aur Duration refresh hote hain; profile kisi maximum refresh count ka daavaa nahi karti.
strengthsEn: Grants 70 temporary Shield Points for a 15-second state.
Each enemy knockdown during the state restores the skill's Shield Points to 70 and resets the duration.
strengthsHi: 15-second State ke liye 70 temporary Shield Points deti hai.
State ke dauraana har enemy Knockdown par Skill ke Shield Points wapas 70 ho jaate hain aur Duration reset hoti hai.
limitationsEn: Shield Points gained from the skill are removed when the state ends.
The cooldown is 75 seconds, and Garena does not publish a maximum refresh count.
limitationsHi: State khatma hone par Skill se mile Shield Points hata jaate hain.
Cooldown 75 seconds hai aur maximum refresh count Garena publish nahi karta.

name: Lila
introEn: Passive that decelerates enemies and vehicles shot with rifles, freezing them and generating Gloo Walls upon knockdown.
introHi: Ek Passive Skill, jo Rifles se hit hue Enemy aur Vehicles ki Speed kama karti hai. Knockdown hone par Enemy freeze ho jaate hain aur extra Gloo Walls milti hain.
currentEn: When hitting enemies or vehicles with rifles or marksman rifles, reduces the enemies' movement speed by 10% or the vehicles' acceleration by 80% for 3 seconds. If the enemy is knocked down while decelerated, freezes them for up to 3 seconds and obtains 2 extra Gloo Walls.
currentHi: Rifles yaa Marksman Rifles se Enemy yaa Vehicles ko hit karne par Enemy ki Movement Speed 10% yaa Vehicles ki Acceleration 80% kama ho jati hai. Ye Effect 3 seconds tak rehta hai. Slow hue Enemy ko Knockdown karne par vaha maximum 3 seconds ke liye freeze ho jata hai aur 2 extra Gloo Walls milti hain.
notesEn: The OB47 patch removed the original 10-second cooldown, making the skill continuously active upon landing successful rifle shots.
notesHi: OB47 Patch ne original 10-second Cooldown hataa diya, isalie saphala Rifle Hits lagane par Skill lagaataara active rehti hai.
historyEn: OB46 (Aug 2024): Introduced. OB47 (Oct 2024): Vehicle decel 50% to 80%, removed 10s skill cooldown. OB49 (21 May 2025): Gloo Wall reward upon knock increased from 1 to 2.
historyHi: OB46 (Aug 2024): Introduce kiya gaya. OB47 (Oct 2024): Vehicle Deceleration 50% se badha kar 80%; 10s Skill Cooldown hataayaa gaya. OB49 (21 May 2025): Knock par Gloo Wall Reward 1 se badha kar 2 kiya gaya.

rowsHi.hi: Enemy ki Movement Speed mein kami

tacticalEn: Use rifle hits to slow a moving enemy before your squad commits; a knock while slowed grants extra Gloo Walls for the next cover/rotation.
tacticalHi: Squad ke commit karne se pahale moving Enemy par Rifle Hits lagaakara usaki Speed kama karen; Slow rehte hue Knockdown karne par agali cover yaa rotation ke liye extra Gloo Walls milti hain.
strengthsEn: Repeated rifle hits can apply the slow without a cooldown; knockdown reward supports cover economy.
strengthsHi: Repeated Rifle Hits binaa Cooldown ke Slow apply kar sakti hain; Knockdown Reward se cover ke options badhate hain.
limitationsEn: The freeze and Gloo Wall reward require a knock while the target is decelerated; the slow alone does not guarantee either.
limitationsHi: Freeze aur Gloo Wall Reward tabhi milate hain jaba target Decelerated rehte hue Knockdown ho; sirpha Slow lagane se inamen se koi Effect pakkaa nahi hota.

name: Maro
introEn: Passive that scales weapon damage based on the distance to the target and deals extra damage to marked enemies.
introHi: Ek Passive Skill, jo target se duri ke hisaaba se Weapon Damage badhati hai aur Mark hue Enemy ko extra Damage deti hai.
currentEn: Damage increases with distance, up to a maximum of 20%. Damage to marked enemies increases by 5%.
currentHi: duri badhane ke saath Damage badhataa hai, maximum 20% tak. Mark hue Enemy ko 5% extra Damage milta hai.
notesEn: Highly synergistic with information-gathering characters like Moco and Shirou.
notesHi: Moco aur Shirou jaise Information dene wale characters ke saath isakaa achchhaa taalamela hai.
historyEn: OB41 (Aug 2023): Damage to marked enemies increased from 3.5% to 5%. OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Maximum distance damage bonus nerfed from 25% to 20%.
historyHi: OB41 (Aug 2023): Mark hue Enemy ko Damage 3.5% se badha kar 5% kiya gaya. OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Maximum Distance Damage Bonus 25% se kam karke 20% kiya gaya.
tacticalEn: Pair with teammate information marks; maintain distance when the engagement allows to benefit from the distance-scaled bonus.
tacticalHi: Teammate ke Information Marks ke saath ise use karen; fight mein maukaa mile to duri banaae rakhen, taaki distance-based Bonus ka fayda mile.
strengthsEn: Combines distance scaling with a separate marked-target bonus; passive has no cooldown.
strengthsHi: Distance Scaling ke saath Mark hue target par alaga Bonus bhi milta hai; Passive ka Cooldown nahi hai.
limitationsEn: The maximum distance bonus scales with range and is not the full 20% at every distance; close-range fights reduce its value.
limitationsHi: Maximum Distance Bonus duri ke saath badhataa hai aur har Range par puraa 20% nahi milta; close-range fights mein isakaa fayda kama hota hai.

name: Shirou
introEn: Passive that marks attackers who hit the user and grants massive armor penetration on the first retaliatory shot.
introHi: Ek Passive Skill, jo aapako hit karne wale attackers ko mark karti hai aur javaabi pahali Shot par bahuta zyada Armor Penetration deti hai.
currentEn: When hit by an enemy from within 100m, the attacker is marked for 8 seconds. Intel is shared with teammates. The first shot on marked enemies has 100% additional armor penetration. Maximum of 4 markings active at once.
currentHi: 100m ke andar maujood Enemy se Hit hone par attacker 8 seconds ke liye mark ho jata hai. Ye jaanakaari teammates ke saath share hoti hai. Mark hue Enemy par pahali Shot ko 100% extra Armor Penetration milti hai. Ek samay mein maximum 4 Marks active raha sakate hain.

rows.value: Garena does not publish current cooldown

notesEn: The mark is universally visible to all teammates. Garena has not republished the cooldown value since it was reduced to 10 seconds in OB36.
notesHi: Mark sabhi teammates ko dikhaai deta hai. OB36 mein Cooldown 10 seconds kie jaane ke baada Garena ne isaki value dobaaraa publish nahi ki hai.
historyEn: OB36 (Sep 2022): Range 80m to 100m, Armor pen to 100%, Cooldown 25s to 10s. OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Marking duration 10s to 8s, Max markings explicitly capped at 4.
historyHi: OB36 (Sep 2022): Range 80m se badha kar 100m, Armor Penetration 100% aur Cooldown 25s se kam karke 10s kiya gaya. OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Marking Duration 10s se kam karke 8s; Maximum Marks ki limit 4 taya ki gayi.
tacticalEn: When your squad is hit, use the shared mark to call the attacker's location and coordinate a response; the first shot receives the penetration bonus.
tacticalHi: Squad ko Hit hone par shared Mark se attacker ki location call karen aur javaabi action coordinate karen; pahali Shot ko Penetration Bonus milta hai.
strengthsEn: Attacker information is shared teamwide; the first retaliatory shot gains 100% additional armor penetration.
strengthsHi: Attacker ki jaanakaari puri team ke saath share hoti hai; javaabi pahali Shot ko 100% extra Armor Penetration milti hai.
limitationsEn: Marking requires Shirou to be hit by an enemy within range; it is reactive, not a proactive scan.
limitationsHi: Marking ke liye Shirou ko Range ke andar kisi Enemy se Hit honaa jaruri hai; ye reactive Skill hai, pahale se Scan nahi karti.

name: Chrono
introEn: Active ability that creates an impenetrable static force field blocking incoming and outgoing damage.
introHi: Ek Active Ability, jo majabuta aur sthira Force Field banati hai. Ye andar aur baahara se aane wala Damage block karti hai.
currentEn: Creates an impenetrable force field that blocks 1,000 damage. Unable to attack outside enemies from within the field. All effects last for 10 seconds.
currentHi: aisaa Force Field banata hai jo 1,000 Damage block karta hai. Field ke andar se baahara maujood Enemy par Attack nahi kara sakate. Sabhi Effects 10 seconds tak rehte hain.
notesEn: The shield blocks damage from all sources, both inside and out. Enemies can enter the shield dome.
notesHi: Shield andar aur baahara, donon tarapha se aane wale sabhi sources ke Damage ko block karta hai. Enemy Shield Dome ke andar aa sakate hain.
historyEn: OB31 (Dec 2021): Removed ability to shoot outward, duration 6s, cooldown 120s. OB45 (Jun 2024): Duration 6s to 8s. OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Cooldown 60s to 45s, Shield HP 800 to 1000, Duration 8s to 10s.
historyHi: OB31 (Dec 2021): baahara ki tarapha Shoot karne ki Ability hataai gayi; Duration 6s aur Cooldown 120s kiya gaya. OB45 (Jun 2024): Duration 6s se badha kar 8s. OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Cooldown 60s se kam karke 45s, Shield HP 800 se badha kar 1,000 aur Duration 8s se badha kar 10s ki gayi.
tacticalEn: Use the field to create a temporary protected space for a reset or revive; remember enemies can enter the dome and you cannot shoot outward.
tacticalHi: Reset yaa Revive ke liye Force Field se thodi dera ka protected area banaaen; yaada rakhen ki Enemy Dome ke andar aa sakate hain aur andar se baahara Shoot nahi kara sakate.
strengthsEn: Blocks up to 1,000 damage and provides a temporary defensive window.
strengthsHi: Maximum 1,000 Damage block karta hai aur thode samay ke liye Defensive Window deta hai.
limitationsEn: The field is static, enemies can enter, and outward attacks are disabled while inside.
limitationsHi: Field Ek hi jagah rehta hai, Enemy andar aa sakate hain aur iske andar rehte hue baahara ki tarapha Attack nahi kara sakate.

name: Dasha
introEn: Passive that rewards knockdowns with a rapidly decaying rate of fire and movement speed boost.
introHi: Ek Passive Skill, jo Knockdown ke baada Rate of Fire aur Movement Speed ka Boost deti hai, lekina ye Boost teji se kama hota jata hai.
currentEn: After knocking down an enemy, enter Highlight mode for 10 seconds. Increases rate of fire by 18% and movement speed by 12% (decays quickly). Consecutively knocking down enemies resets the countdown and further boosts rate of fire by 4% and movement speed by 3%.
currentHi: Enemy ko Knockdown karne ke baada 10 seconds ke liye Highlight Mode shuru hota hai. Rate of Fire 18% aur Movement Speed 12% badha jati hai (Boost teji se kama hota hai). Lagaataara Knockdown karne par Countdown reset hota hai aur Rate of Fire 4% aur Movement Speed 3% aur badha jati hai.

rows.hi: Rate of Fire ka Base Bonus

notesEn: Movement speed has a global maximum; bonuses from skills, items and events cannot exceed it.
notesHi: Movement Speed ki Ek global maximum limit hai; Skills, items aur events se milne wale bonuses is limit ko paar nahi kara sakate.
historyEn: OB39 (Mar 2023): Skill entirely reworked to Highlight mode (18% RoF, 12% Spd, 6s duration). OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Duration buffed from 6s to 10s.
historyHi: OB39 (Mar 2023): Skill ko puri taraha Highlight Mode mein rework kiya gaya (18% RoF, 12% Speed, 6s Duration). OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Duration 6s se badha kar 10s ki gayi.
rowsHi: Rate of Fire ka Base Bonus
tacticalEn: After a knock, use the Highlight window to reposition or continue pressure; chained knockdowns refresh the timer and increase both bonuses.
tacticalHi: Knock ke baada Highlight Window ka istemaala reposition karne yaa pressure jaari rakhane ke liye karen; lagaataara Knockdown karne par Timer reset hota hai aur donon Bonuses badhate hain.
strengthsEn: Knockdown-triggered momentum can be chained; no cooldown listed.
strengthsHi: Knockdown se milne wala Momentum lagaataara banaae rakhaa jaa sakataa hai; koi Cooldown listed nahi hai.
limitationsEn: Highlight requires a knockdown to start; its bonuses decay quickly and movement speed remains subject to the global cap.
limitationsHi: Highlight shuru karne ke liye Knockdown jaruri hai; iske Bonuses teji se kama hote hain aur Movement Speed global cap ke andar hi rehti hai.

name: D-BEE
introEn: A passive ability that boosts movement speed and accuracy while firing on the move.
introHi: Ek Passive Ability, jo chalate hue Fire karne par Movement Speed aur Accuracy badhati hai.
currentEn: While firing and moving at the same time, movement speed increases by 50% and accuracy increases by 60%.
currentHi: Ek hi samay mein Move karte hue Fire karne par Movement Speed 50% aur Accuracy 60% badha jati hai.

rows.value: Not listed on the official profile

notesEn: The bonus requires movement and firing to happen simultaneously; standing still while firing does not meet the stated trigger.
The official character page gives a short description; the numerical values are documented in Garena's OB46 patch notes.
No separate duration or cooldown is published in the official sources checked.
notesHi: Bonus ke liye Move karna aur Fire karna Ek hi samay par jaruri hai; khade rahakara Fire karne se ye Trigger puraa nahi hota.
Official Character Page par chhotaa description diya gaya hai; numeric values Garena ke OB46 Patch Notes mein darja hain.
jaanche gaye official sources mein alaga Duration yaa Cooldown publish nahi kiya gaya hai.
historyEn: OB28 (Jun 2021): D-Bee introduced with Bullet Beats.
OB35 (20 Jul 2022): Movement-speed bonus increased from 10% to 20%; accuracy increased from 20% to 45%.
OB46 (3 Sep 2024): Movement-speed bonus increased from 30% to 50%; accuracy set to 60%.
historyHi: OB28 (Jun 2021): D-Bee ko Bullet Beats ke saath introduce kiya gaya.
OB35 (20 Jul 2022): Movement Speed Bonus 10% se badha kar 20%; Accuracy 20% se badha kar 45% ki gayi.
OB46 (3 Sep 2024): Movement Speed Bonus 30% se badha kar 50%; Accuracy 60% taya ki gayi.
subtitle: OB55 values reconciled 15 Nov 2026
tacticalEn: The effect is conditional on simultaneous movement and firing; it does not provide the stated bonuses while stationary.
In squad play, communicate when you are repositioning so teammates can maintain shared awareness of your movement.
tacticalHi: Effect ke liye Move karna aur Fire karna Ek saath jaruri hai; khade rehne par bataae gaye Bonuses nahi milate.
Squad mein reposition karte samay teammates ko call den, taaki unhe aapaki movement ki jaanakaari rahe.
strengthsEn: Provides two simultaneous passive bonuses under its stated trigger.
No active-skill activation input is required.
strengthsHi: bataae gaye Trigger ke dauraana Ek saath do Passive Bonuses milate hain.
Active Skill ko manually activate karne ki jarurata nahi hai.
limitationsEn: The effect is conditional and does not apply when the character is stationary.
The official sources checked do not specify a separate duration or cooldown.
limitationsHi: ye Effect condition par nirbhara hai aur stationary rehne par laagu nahi hota.
jaanche gaye official sources mein alaga Duration yaa Cooldown nahi diya gaya hai.

name: LUQUETA
introEn: A passive ability that permanently raises maximum Shield Points with each elimination, up to a capped bonus.
introHi: Ek Passive Ability, jo har Elimination par maximum Shield Points badhati hai. Isakaa Bonus Ek taya Limit tak hi stack hota hai.
currentEn: Each elimination increases maximum Shield Points by 15. The bonus stacks up to 45 Shield Points in total and is cleared when the player is eliminated or the round resets.
currentHi: har Elimination par maximum Shield Points 15 badhate hain. Bonus total 45 Shield Points tak stack hota hai aur player ke eliminate hone yaa Round reset hone par hata jata hai.

rows.value: Not listed on the official profile

notesEn: The bonus affects maximum Shield Points, not ordinary HP.
The effect is personal to the player using Luqueta; it is not described as a squad-wide reward.
Garena's OB49 notes confirm the current +15 per elimination and +45 maximum.
notesHi: ye Bonus maximum Shield Points badhata hai, saamaanya HP nahi.
ye Effect sirpha Luqueta istemaala karne wale player ko milta hai; ise puri Squad ka Reward nahi bataayaa gaya hai.
Garena ke OB49 notes current +15 per Elimination aur +45 maximum ki pushti karte hain.
historyEn: OB23 (29 Jul 2020): Hat Trick introduced as a maximum-HP increase per elimination, capped at 35.
OB46 (1 Sep 2024): The HP bonus was converted to Shield Points; +25 per elimination, up to +50.
OB48 (Feb 2025): The per-elimination and maximum values were reduced to +20 and +40.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Maximum stacks increased to 3; +15 per elimination and +45 maximum.
historyHi: OB23 (29 Jul 2020): Hat Trick ko har Elimination par maximum HP badhaane vaali Skill ke rupa mein introduce kiya gaya, jisaki limit 35 thi.
OB46 (1 Sep 2024): HP Bonus ko Shield Points mein badalaa gaya; har Elimination par +25, maximum +50 tak.
OB48 (Feb 2025): har Elimination aur maximum values kam karke +20 aur +40 ki gain.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Maximum Stacks badha kar 3 kie gaye; har Elimination par +15 aur maximum +45 kiya gaya.

source.label: Garena — OB46 Patch Notes (Shield Points conversion)

subtitle: OB55 values reconciled 15 Nov 2026
tacticalEn: The passive bonus builds only from the user's own eliminations and remains until the stated reset condition.
Keep track of the current round state because the accumulated bonus does not carry through player elimination or a round reset.
tacticalHi: Passive Bonus sirpha user ke apane Eliminations se badhataa hai aur bataai gayi Reset Condition tak banaa rehta hai.
Current Round ki sthiti par dhyaana rakhen, kyonki Player Elimination yaa Round Reset hone par jamaa Bonus aage nahi rehta.
strengthsEn: The bonus can accumulate across up to three eliminations.
The increased maximum Shield Points remain for the rest of the round unless a reset condition occurs.
strengthsHi: Bonus maximum tina Eliminations tak jamaa ho sakataa hai.
badhe hue maximum Shield Points Reset Condition na hone par Round ke baaki samay bane rehte hain.
limitationsEn: The ability needs eliminations to build value; it does not grant the full bonus at the start.
The accumulated effect is cleared on player elimination or round reset.
limitationsHi: Bonus badhaane ke liye Eliminations jaruri hain; shuruaata mein puraa Bonus nahi milta.
Player Elimination yaa Round Reset hone par jamaa Effect hata jata hai.

name: KELLY
introEn: A passive ability that increases sprinting speed and activates Deadly Velocity after a sustained sprint, empowering the first shot that hits a target during its active window.
introHi: Ek Passive Ability, jo Sprinting Speed badhati hai. Lagaataara Sprint karne ke baada Deadly Velocity activate hoti hai aur isaki active window mein target ko hit karne vaali pahali Shot ko extra Damage milta hai.
currentEn: Sprinting speed increases by 6%. Sprint continuously for 4 seconds to activate Deadly Velocity. The effect lasts 5 seconds; the first shot that hits a target during this window deals 106% damage.
currentHi: Sprinting Speed 6% badha jati hai. Deadly Velocity activate karne ke liye 4 seconds lagaataara Sprint karen. Effect 5 seconds tak rehta hai; is Window ke dauraana target ko hit karne vaali pahali Shot 106% Damage deti hai.

rows.value: First 1 shot that hits a target
Not listed on the official profile

notesEn: The official character page specifies the sprint trigger, 5-second active window and 106% damage on the first shot that hits a target.
The profile does not publish a separate cooldown value.
OB47's awakening-system change replaced non-awakened skills with their awakened versions for all players; both character appearances remained selectable.
Garena's official localized Kelly profile also lists a 6% sprint-speed increase alongside Deadly Velocity.
notesHi: Official Character Page Sprint Trigger, 5-second Active Window aur target ko hit karne vaali pahali Shot par 106% Damage ki pushti karta hai.
Profile mein alaga Cooldown Value publish nahi ki gayi hai.
OB47 ke Awakening-system badalaava mein sabhi players ke liye non-awakened Skills ki jagah awakened versions ne le li; donon Character Appearances ab bhi selectable hain.
Garena ki official localized Kelly Profile mein Deadly Velocity ke saath 6% Sprinting Speed Increase bhi di gayi hai.
historyEn: 2018: Kelly introduced with Dash.
OB20 (Feb 2020): Awakened Kelly and Deadly Velocity introduced.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Garena replaced non-awakened skills with their awakened versions for all players; Kelly's Deadly Velocity became the standard skill profile.
historyHi: 2018: Kelly ko Dash ke saath introduce kiya gaya.
OB20 (Feb 2020): Awakened Kelly aur Deadly Velocity introduce kie gaye.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Garena ne sabhi players ke liye non-awakened Skills ki jagah awakened versions laagu kie; Kelly ki Deadly Velocity standard Skill Profile bana gayi.

source.label: Garena — Kelly official localized profile (6% sprint speed)
Garena — Kelly Awakening / OB20 historical profile

subtitle: OB55 values reconciled 15 Nov 2026
tacticalEn: The activation requirement is a continuous 4-second sprint, so the ability is not immediately active when a match begins or after every movement burst.
The 5-second window is limited; the enhanced effect applies only to the first shot that hits a target within that window.
tacticalHi: Activation ke liye lagaataara 4-second Sprint jaruri hai, isalie Match shuru hote hi yaa har chhoti movement burst ke baada Ability turnta active nahi hoti.
5-second Window simita hai; is dauraana target ko hit karne vaali sirpha pahali Shot ko enhanced Effect milta hai.
strengthsEn: The trigger and active window are clearly defined in Garena's current profile.
The ability is passive and does not require a separate activation button.
strengthsHi: Garena ki current Profile mein Trigger Aura active Window saapha bataae gaye hain.
ye Passive Ability hai aur iske liye alaga Activation Button ki jarurata nahi hoti.
limitationsEn: The effect requires a continuous sprint before activation.
Only the first shot that hits a target during the 5-second window receives the stated 106% damage effect.
limitationsHi: Activate hone se pahale lagaataara Sprint karna jaruri hai.
5-second Window mein target ko hit karne vaali sirpha pahali Shot ko hi 106% Damage Effect milta hai.

name: HAYATO
introEn: A passive ability that combines armor penetration and frontal damage reduction, with both effects scaling as maximum HP is lost.
introHi: Ek Passive Ability, jo Armor Penetration aur saamane se milne wale Damage Reduction ko jodati hai. Maximum HP kama hone ke saath donon Effects badhate hain.
